entries.name: Bandit
entries.use_for: Find common security issues in Python code.
entries.why: The standard Python security linter from PyCQA.

entries.name: Checkov
entries.use_for: Scan Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Dockerfiles and more for security misconfigurations
entries.why: Leading open IaC scanner with 1000+ built-in policies and CI integrations

entries.name: CrowdSec
entries.use_for: Open-source, crowd-powered intrusion prevention that detects and blocks malicious IPs
entries.why: Modern fail2ban successor with shared blocklists and bouncers for Nginx, Traefik, Cloudflare and more

entries.name: DOMPurify
entries.use_for: Fast, tolerant XSS sanitizer for HTML, MathML and SVG
entries.why: The trusted HTML sanitizer from security firm Cure53; the default fix for rendering untrusted HTML

entries.name: Falco
entries.use_for: Cloud-native runtime threat detection for hosts, containers and Kubernetes
entries.why: CNCF graduated project; eBPF-based detection of suspicious behavior at runtime

entries.name: Gitleaks
entries.use_for: Detect hardcoded secrets like API keys and passwords in git repos and files.
entries.why: The most popular open-source secret scanner, easy to run in pre-commit and CI.

entries.name: Grype
entries.use_for: Vulnerability scanner for container images, filesystems and SBOMs
entries.why: Fast, accurate CVE scanning that pairs with Syft SBOMs; easy to drop into CI

entries.name: Helmet
entries.use_for: Secure Express/Node apps by setting HTTP security headers like CSP and HSTS
entries.why: Standard one-line hardening middleware for Express, with millions of weekly downloads

entries.name: Kingfisher
entries.use_for: Detect secrets in code and history and validate whether they are live.
entries.why: MongoDB-maintained scanner that adds live validation and blast-radius mapping.

entries.name: Lynis
entries.use_for: Audit Linux, macOS and Unix hosts for security hardening and compliance.
entries.why: Long-standing, agentless host auditing tool with actionable hardening suggestions.

entries.name: Nuclei
entries.use_for: Scan web apps, APIs and infrastructure for vulnerabilities using YAML templates.
entries.why: Fast template-driven scanner with a huge community template library.

entries.name: OSV-Scanner
entries.use_for: Find known vulnerabilities in your project's dependencies using the OSV database.
entries.why: Google's SCA scanner backed by the open, multi-ecosystem OSV.dev database.

entries.name: OWASP Nettacker
entries.use_for: Automate network and web reconnaissance and vulnerability scanning.
entries.why: OWASP-maintained modular scanning framework; Apache-2.0.

entries.name: Semgrep
entries.use_for: Scan source code for bugs and security issues with fast, customizable pattern rules.
entries.why: Lightweight, multi-language SAST with a large rule registry; CE is LGPL-2.1.

entries.name: SkillSpector
entries.use_for: Scan AI agent skills for vulnerabilities, malicious patterns and risky behavior before installing.
entries.why: NVIDIA-maintained scanner for the agent-skill supply chain; Apache-2.0.

entries.name: Syft
entries.use_for: Generate SBOMs (SPDX, CycloneDX) from container images and filesystems
entries.why: The most used open SBOM generator; the foundation for supply-chain scanning pipelines

entries.name: Trivy
entries.use_for: Scan containers, filesystems, repos, IaC and Kubernetes for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
entries.why: All-in-one, widely adopted scanner that drops easily into CI; Apache-2.0.

entries.name: TruffleHog
entries.use_for: Find, verify and analyze leaked credentials in git, CI, cloud storage and more
entries.why: Verifies detected secrets against live APIs to cut false positives; 800+ detectors

entries.name: Vuls
entries.use_for: Scan Linux/FreeBSD servers, containers and libraries for known CVEs without agents.
entries.why: Agentless vulnerability scanner for server fleets with multiple data sources.

entries.name: ZAP
entries.use_for: Test web applications for vulnerabilities with an intercepting proxy and automated scans.
entries.why: The most widely used free DAST tool, scriptable and CI-friendly.
